properties.name: Blue Licks Battlefield State Resort Park
properties.title: Blue Licks Battlefield State Resort Park
properties.history: Last major Revolutionary War battle in Kentucky (August 19, 1782): Kentucky militia pursuing British-allied Native forces from Bryan’s Station were ambushed at the Licking River; Daniel Boone’s son Israel was among the dead. Pioneer Museum and monument interpret the battle and earlier salt-lick history.
